negative_snippets:
The stay was decent overall, though there were a few areas that could be improved.
The hotel had some water issues at certain times, which caused minor inconvenience. While it wasn’t constant, it is something that should be addressed for better guest comfort.
The room was on the smaller side, especially if you have luggage, but it was functional and sufficient for a short stay. Maintenance and cleanliness were acceptable.
Service was mixed. Some staff members were helpful, while others could have been more attentive and welcoming. With better consistency and communication, the service experience could improve noticeably.
Food was average.
Overall, this hotel is okay for a short or budget-conscious stay. With improvements in water facilities, service consistency, room comfort, and food quality, it has the potential to offer a better experience.
